d:
Step back into the charm of early 2000s Bollywood with “Jab Tujhe Maine Dekha Nahin Tha”, a beautiful romantic melody from Pyaar Ishq Aur Mohabbat (2001). Featuring Aftab Shivdasani and Keerthi Reddy, this soulful duet is beautifully sung by Udit Narayan and Sadhana Sargam.
Jab Tujhe Maine Dekha Nahin Tha | Pyaar Ishq Aur Mohabbat (2001) | Aftab Shivdasani, Keerthi Reddy
Song: Jab Tujhe Maine Dekha Nahin Tha
Movie: Pyaar Ishq Aur Mohabbat (2001)
Star Cast: Aftab Shivdasani, Keerthi Reddy
Singers: Sadhana Sargam, Udit Narayan
Music Director : Viju Shah
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi
